valuation_template_rationale: Corsair has positive GAAP operating income and cash flow, management supplies a current full-year earnings range, and the business has sufficiently established economics for normalized forward earnings; the method explicitly adjusts non-GAAP guidance for stock compensation, amortization, cyclicality, working capital and net debt.
bear_assumptions: USD 0.50 normalized forward EPS at 12x as component constraints, tariffs, promotions or weak discretionary demand reverse margin progress and working-capital cash conversion fades.
base_assumptions: USD 0.75 normalized forward EPS at 15x as unchanged guidance converts, peripherals and creator products offset component softness, improved gross margin persists and dilution is broadly contained.
bull_assumptions: USD 1.00 normalized forward EPS at 18x as premium ecosystem growth broadens, Fanatec and Elgato execution improves, component supply normalizes, and sustained mix plus cost discipline lift cash earnings.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh Q2 or later primary evidence and a revised scenario set clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if peripherals growth no longer offsets component weakness, gross margin reverts, adjusted earnings fail to convert to GAAP and free cash flow, inventory rebuilds ahead of demand, acquired brands consume capital without returns, or dilution overwhelms repurchases and per-share growth.
